purpose: Picks one option from a short list. Opens a list of options with typeahead and full keyboard support.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label associated with the select

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when no option is selected

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden native select submits the value with the form

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown below the select

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text shown below the select

props.name: variant
props.description: Validation style. Defaults to error when errorMessage is set, otherwise default

whenToUse: When the user must choose one option from four to about fifteen choices
When screen space is limited and listing all options inline would crowd the layout
Inside a form for fields like country, timezone, or category
whenNotToUse: For fewer than four options — use RadioGroup
For long or searchable lists — use Combobox
For multiple simultaneous selections — use a checkbox group
For yes/no decisions — use Checkbox or Switch
antiPatterns: Using Select when only two or three options exist
Omitting a label — always provide a visible label

anatomy: Label above; 40px field-styled button with the value or placeholder and a chevron; the shared list box popover with a check on the selected option; helper or error text
sizes: Field `size-control-md` (40px), `space-component-padding-field` sides, extra end padding for the chevron
states: Same field states as Input: `color-border-input`, `color-border-input-hover`, focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`, error `color-border-danger`
The option list uses `shadow-component-menu`, `color-state-layer` on hover and focus, and `color-text-link` for the selected option
motion: Popover enters with `motion-easing-enter` over `motion-duration-overlay` and exits with `motion-easing-exit` over `motion-duration-overlay-exit`; chevron rotates over `motion-duration-standard`

a11yNotes: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup listbox, named by the label and the current value
Enter, Space or Arrow Down open the list; arrows move; Enter selects; Escape closes; typing selects by first letters
Error messages are linked via aria-describedby
A hidden native select keeps form submission and autofill working
